gen-dafont-over-there-gf-podkova: Commanding and a bit military, Over There draws tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. Podkova takes over below as a classic serif with a broad, welcoming c, lighter and bookish.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-rokkitt: Over There has the weight of a drawn wire, with generous white space between its letters. Rokkitt, a text serif whose c is as open as a bent paperclip, keeps things bookish and light beneath it.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-sanchez: Over There looks thin yet never gets thinner anywhere, each commanding letter drawn by one fixed-width nib. Sanchez, a text serif with a c opened like calipers, does the talking.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-solway: Commanding and vintage-military, Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib and plenty of white space between letters. Solway, a text serif, brings stencil-flat line weight and a generous entry into the e's eye.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-yuji-boku: Commanding, vintage-military lettering with generous white space fills Over There. Yuji Boku, a serif, holds each stroke at one thickness like a drawn cable, and its c, pulled wide like a bracelet, brings editorial dignity beneath.
gen-dafont-over-there-nunito-sans: Commanding and vintage-military, Over There keeps all its stems and crossbars at a single thickness throughout. Nunito Sans reads soft, open-mouthed curves carrying you along.
gen-dafont-ozone-bitter: Bitter, a grounded slab-serif, has a very large lowercase eye. Ozone heads the page in geometric single-weight strokes, and Bitter's see-through s shapes keep long paragraphs rolling along dependably.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-alpino: Ozone glides under the eye like wire, every stem and crossbar sharing one thickness, with wide-set curve ends. Alpino, cozy and casual, loosens that technical heading up.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-nunito: Nunito reads friendly and approachable, with big round bowls. Against Ozone's technical single-thickness strokes, Nunito's terminals finishing well away from the stem supply a soft, contemporary counterweight.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-quicksand: Approachable and soft, the body text hangs under Ozone's geometric, technical heading. Quicksand brings tall, bulb-like lowercase bowls and a uniform bar thickness that echo the heading's single-weight strokes.
